% Pattern: file/line-ends. A file from an old Mac ends each line with a CR only. The test gives the file to source.Open with CR line ends.
% from 1007.4365v1
% lineends cr
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1
\documentclass{amsart}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}
\begin{document}
% A comment before the first item.
\begin{theorem}
A theorem.
\end{theorem}
\begin{lemma}
A lemma.
\end{lemma}
\end{document}
